title: Yellow Mustardy Dutch Egg Rolls Tagine
description: A sugar-free friendly Dutch dish featuring egg rolls in a mustardy and glassy-jelly sauce, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe uses kombu cold extract for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large ceramic tagine, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mustard, kombu cold extract, salt, and black pepper.
Add the mustard mixture to the tagine and stir to combine.
Add the egg rolls to the tagine and pour in the water.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the egg rolls are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
